learning_objectives.en: Understand the role of examples, reasons and attitudes in an academic talk.
learning_objectives.vi: Hiểu vai trò ví dụ, lý do và quan điểm trong bài nói học thuật.

content.en: A speaker may describe factors in order (first/second/third/finally). Use headings as a table before listening; do not use details to substitute the main category.
content.vi: Người nói chia theo first/second/third/finally. Kẻ bảng nhãn chủ đề trước khi nghe; không thay ý chính bằng chi tiết.

vocabulary.example_en: The first date was a distractor.
vocabulary.example_vi: Ngày đầu là thông tin gây nhiễu.

vocabulary.example_en: The agent confirmed the new time.
vocabulary.example_vi: Nhân viên xác nhận giờ mới.

strategies.en: First → safety; second → connectivity; third → parking; fourth → car speed limits; finally → culture.
strategies.vi: Theo dấu hiệu thứ tự: an toàn → kết nối → giữ xe → giới hạn tốc độ → văn hóa.

common_mistakes.wrong: The first reason not to cycle is weather.
common_mistakes.correct: The first reason is fear of traffic.

reason.en: The lecturer says cities with similar weather cycle at different rates; main reason is perceived safety.
reason.vi: Giảng viên nói thời tiết tương tự nhưng tỷ lệ khác; nguyên nhân chính đầu tiên là sợ xe cộ.

mini_review.en: Create your own five-row table summarising cycling factors and one example each.
mini_review.vi: Tự lập bảng năm yếu tố xe đạp với một ví dụ mỗi yếu tố.

audios.title: Lecture: planning for cycling cities
audios.transcript:
Lecturer: In today’s lecture, I want to look at why some cities have very high levels of cycling while others, with similar weather and geography, have very low levels.
The first factor is safety, or more precisely, how safe people feel. Surveys consistently show that the most common reason people give for not cycling is fear of traffic. Painting a line on a busy road does little to change this. What makes a difference is physical separation – a kerb, a row of parked cars or a strip of planting between cyclists and motor vehicles.
The second factor is the network. A cycle lane that ends suddenly at a busy junction is almost useless. Researchers talk about the importance of connectivity: people will only cycle regularly if they can complete their whole journey safely. In one city, building just three short links between existing lanes increased cycling on the whole network by around twenty per cent.
Third, parking. Many people own a bicycle but do not use it because they have nowhere secure to leave it, either at home or at their destination. Secure parking at railway stations is particularly effective, because it allows people to combine cycling with train travel.
The fourth factor is less obvious: speed limits for cars. When a city lowered the limit on residential streets to thirty kilometres an hour, the number of children cycling to school rose noticeably, even though no new lanes were built.
Finally, culture. In cities where cycling is common, it is seen as a normal way to travel, not a sport. People cycle in ordinary clothes, and politicians and business leaders are often seen on bicycles. That image matters, but it usually follows the practical changes rather than coming first.

instruction.en: Write the main factor described by each clue.
instruction.vi: Viết yếu tố chính tương ứng từng dữ kiện.

questions.prompt_en: Fear of traffic relates to which factor?
questions.prompt_vi: Sợ giao thông thuộc yếu tố nào?
questions.explanation_en: The lecturer names safety as factor one.
questions.explanation_vi: Giảng viên gọi an toàn là yếu tố một.

questions.prompt_en: A cycle lane ending at a junction demonstrates lack of ____.
questions.prompt_vi: Làn xe đạp kết thúc ở ngã tư cho thấy thiếu ____.
questions.explanation_en: The network must connect all the way.

questions.prompt_en: Secure bicycle storage at stations solves a ____ problem.
questions.prompt_vi: Giữ xe an toàn ở ga xử lý vấn đề ____.
questions.explanation_vi: Yếu tố thứ ba là giữ xe.

questions.prompt_vi: Giới hạn 30 km/h liên quan ____ của xe.
questions.explanation_en: Factor four is lower car speed limits.
questions.explanation_vi: Yếu tố bốn là giới hạn tốc độ.

questions.prompt_en: Normal everyday use of bicycles relates to local ____.
questions.prompt_vi: Dùng xe đạp như sinh hoạt thường ngày liên quan ____.
questions.explanation_en: Final factor is a cycling culture.
questions.explanation_vi: Yếu tố cuối là văn hóa đi xe đạp.

questions.prompt_en: What separation might protect cyclists from cars?
questions.prompt_vi: Có thể ngăn làn xe đạp với ôtô bằng gì?
questions.explanation_en: A kerb is explicitly one possible physical barrier.
questions.explanation_vi: Kerb là một giải pháp phân cách được nói rõ.

questions.prompt_en: What kind of parking is particularly effective?
questions.prompt_vi: Kiểu đỗ xe nào đặc biệt hiệu quả?
questions.explanation_en: Secure parking at railway stations helps multimodal travel.
questions.explanation_vi: Giữ xe an toàn ở ga giúp kết nối nhiều phương tiện.

questions.prompt_en: What was increased by about twenty per cent after three short links?
questions.prompt_vi: Điều gì tăng khoảng 20% khi nối ba đoạn đường?
questions.explanation_en: The entire network saw cycling increase, not car journeys.
questions.explanation_vi: Lượng xe đạp tăng trên toàn mạng, không phải ôtô.

instruction.en: Choose the claim consistent with the talk.
